messages.subject: MSstats.daily v2.1.5 release
messages.body_plain:
MSstats.daily v2.1.5 is released in msstats.org <http://msstats.org> on February 16, 2014.

We will call development version of MSstats, Msstats.daily. MSstats will be updated in Bioconductor on its release schedule. MSstats.daily will be posted on 'INSTALLATION' page of msstats.org <http://msstats.org> more frequently even with minor updates.

> 1. dataProcess function

> (a)  change the value for constant normalization which equalize medians across runs, from constant to equalizeMedians. Now default of normalization is equalizeMedians, which is exactly the same as previous constant in normalization. Please check ?dataProcess in order to check the changes in dataProcess.

> (b)  improve normalization for experiments if all the transitions of a biological or a technical replicate are split into multiple ’methods’ due to the technical limitations.

> (c)  new warning message for balanced design : MSstats needs balanced design data with missing feature intensities as NA in the datasets. If there is any missing feature rows caused unbalanced design, warning message will show which subject , condition, and features are missing rows.

> 2. groupComparison function

> - change the name of option for unequal variance among features, from featureVar to equalFeatureVar. Please check ?groupComparison.

> 3. designSampleSize function

(a)  fixed bugs for expanded scope of replication.

(b)  new options, equalFeatureVar as the same as groupComparison function. Please check

?designSampleSize.

4. quantification function

(a)  fixed bugs reported from multiple users.

(b)  show the progress in Console.

(c)  new options, scopeOfBioReplication, scopeOfTechReplication, interference, equalFeatureVar as the same as groupComparison function. Please check ?quantification.

5. dataProcessPlots, groupComparisonPlots, modelBasedQCPlots functions

(a) add some options for size of labeling, dots. Please check help file using ?dataProcessPlots, ?groupComparisonPlots, ?modelBasedQCPlots

> (b) heatmap : first new option numProtein is the number of proteins which will be presented in each heatmap. The second new option, clustering, determines how to order proteins and comparisons.

6. automatically generate ’msstats.log’ in working directory. ’msstats.log’ will have session in- formation, options that users used, and progress.

7. add suffix with number if there is the file with the same names in order to keep all the files in working directory.
Welcome to hear your feedback.

Meena
